== English Tatooine comparison ==
The dated replacement explicitly makes the bottom-card move public by replacing take with reveal. The complete full face and D-E1 slip agree. The 2002 Supplement p. 4 clarifies the Force Pile operation and whose Podrace may be placed out of play. It does not replace the 2001 game text with reveal.
